description: Agent Goals: submit an agent’s goals as recorded: each goal with its id, the outcome wanted, read for activity wording such as improve, optimize or work on, what it covers and what it leaves out, how to tell it is met, read for opinion wording such as looks good or everyone is happy, when it is due and when it is next reviewed. The signed report gives every goal with the parts it is missing, any vague wording read from it, whether its review comes only after its horizon and its status as complete, partial, vague or unstated, counts the goals complete, partial, vague and unstated, and lists every vague word found, and names goals stated too vaguely to act on: outcomes worded as an activity with no figure or date, and success tests that leave success to opinion; then goals with no scope, no success test or no horizon or review point, and reviews set only after the horizon, with the fix for each. A goal with no outcome is not stated. This reads the outcome an agent works toward, recorded before any promise exists: a promise once made is wever_commitment-specificity-check, the success criteria of an evaluation plan are wever_evaluation-design-check, one job’s objective in a resume pack is wever_job-handoff-pack and whether a handoff format carries the goal to the next agent is wever_context-transfer-check. Verdict statement_vague, statement_partial, goal_unstated or statement_complete. POST /api/goal-statement-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.

horizon.description: When it is due, as a date.

id.description: The goal id, such as g1.

outcome.description: The outcome wanted, read for activity wording such as improve or work on.

review_at.description: When it is next reviewed, as a date.

success_test.description: How to tell it is met, read for opinion wording such as looks good.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
